findings.issue_text: [ADVISORY] The integration test asserts only that run C is not Blocking; it does not check that run A's finding was closed in the findings ledger, and has no case where the adopted run predates a new commit. A regression where the gate passes for another reason, or A's finding stays open in findings.jsonl, would go unnoticed. The test does fail without the adoption line.
